2.sql: SELECT `호관`, ROUND(CAST(`IP가_부여된_단말기_수` AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / `호실_수`, 2) AS `평균_단말기_수` FROM BUILDING_IP_COUNTS;

SELECT 
    `BUILDING_IP_COUNTS`.`호관` AS `호관`,
    `BUILDING_IP_COUNTS`.`호실_수` AS `예상_호실_개수`,
    COALESCE(`r`.`실제_호실_개수`, 0) AS `실제_호실_개수`
FROM 
    `BUILDING_IP_COUNTS`
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        LEFT(`사용호실`, 1) AS `호관`,
        COUNT(*) AS `실제_호실_개수`
    FROM 
        `ROOM_IP_COUNTS`
    GROUP BY 
        LEFT(`사용호실`, 1)
) `r` ON `BUILDING_IP_COUNTS`.`호관` = `r`.`호관`;
